(2) The camera zooms in for a close-up on the dragon's face, highlighting its fierce expression and wooden-textured scales. A visible rectangular hole in the wall reveals where the tail segment has been removed, creating a gap between the dragon's body and a large yellow lantern sign for a neighboring restaurant.
